newsitem.title: GERMANY: INSTANT VIEW - Daimler 9-mo sales figures.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - Daimler 9-mo sales figures.

text.p: Following is a selection of auto industry analysts' reactions to Daimler-Benz AG reporting that group nine-month sales climbed to 75.91 billion marks from 72.78 billion marks.

LOTHAR LUBINETSKI, ENSKILDA CORPORATE: "The figures are quite positive. They show Daimler is finally on the right track. Mercedes is doing well, demand for the E-class is very strong, but trucks are still weak. On balance the figures were probably slightly higher than expected. DASA is also showing signs of improvement and will get a big boost from yesterday's Airbus order."
